why: chain_runner writes meta.elapsed_s for the CURRENT process only, so a resumed run's results.json understates elapsed. This run executed in 7 segments across three days under the OBJ-020 retry policy; these figures are recovered from evidence-file timestamps, segmented on gaps longer than 10 minutes. Basis: Observed.
derivedFrom: evidence file mtimes, gap threshold 600 s

totals.note: Idle time is the 30-minute retry waits and the overnight gap, not execution. Elapsed counts only time inside a running segment.
